scene:
That man, luminous and out of his body, standing unnoticed in the middle of somebody else's living room while two friends sit watching television — he is looking at what is on the screen, and neither of them knows he is in the room.

No text or lettering anywhere.

scene:
Two friends talking across a kitchen table mid-sentence, and that man standing luminous and out of his body directly between them, close enough to hear every word, entirely unseen by either of them.

No text or lettering anywhere.

A hand folding a small slip of paper with a single numeral written on it and closing it inside a fist, and behind that hand a room of people sitting in a loose circle watching it happen — the test being set in front of witnesses.

No words or lettering anywhere except that single handwritten numeral.

A laboratory bench arranged in a half circle around one ordinary empty chair, every instrument, lens and sensor aimed carefully at the seat — a great apparatus pointed at nothing, measuring something that is not there to be measured.

No text or lettering anywhere.

A deep stack of handwritten statements on a plain desk, dozens of loose pages each covered in a different person's handwriting, the pile square and heavy and drawn as a record that has been kept.

No lettering that can be read — the handwriting is only the texture of writing.

A young soldier seen from behind at dusk, alone between the tents of a distant camp, doing something small and ordinary — carrying a mug, head down — unaware that anyone is watching him at all.

No text or lettering anywhere.

A large plain government building at night, flat and anonymous and enormous, every window dark except one lit square high up on its face.

No text or lettering anywhere.

A bare room with a table, a chair, a notepad and a stopwatch — one person sitting with their eyes closed and their hands flat on the table, and a second person opposite them writing down what is said, the whole thing drawn as a procedure being carried out rather than anything mystical.

No text or lettering anywhere.

A long room of grey filing cabinets standing in rows under a low ceiling, one drawer pulled right out and packed tight with folders — an enormous amount of money spent, kept as paper.

No text or lettering anywhere.
